zoom.selectRegion: Select a zoom region to adjust

focusMode.title: Focus Mode
focusMode.autoDescription: Camera follows the recorded cursor position
focusMode.lockedDisclaimer: Controlled by the global Auto-Focus toggle in the timeline. Turn it off to set focus mode per zoom.

speed.selectRegion: Select a speed region to adjust
speed.previewFrameSteppingHint: Above {{native}}×, preview is frame-stepped and muted. Export is unaffected.

layout.title: Layout
layout.screenFramingHint: Drag the screen in the preview. Scroll to change scale.
layout.reactiveWebcamDescription: Camera smoothly shrinks while the video is zoomed in, so it stays out of the way.
layout.help: How the webcam is composed with the screen: picture-in-picture, vertical stack, dual frame, mask shape, size, and mirroring.
layout.webcamCornerRadiusDescription: Rounds the camera corners as a percentage of its shorter side.

effects.title: Video Effects
effects.help: Frame styling for the recording: background blur, drop shadow, motion blur, corner radius, and padding around the video.
effects.blurBgDescription: Softens the background behind the recording.
effects.motionBlurDescription: Adds blur during screen zoom and pan animations.
effects.shadowDescription: Adjusts the shadow behind the screen recording.
effects.roundnessDescription: Rounds the screen recording’s corners. Camera corners are separate.
effects.paddingDescription: Adds space around the recording to show more background.

background.title: Background
background.help: Choose what appears behind the recording: a bundled wallpaper image, a solid color, a gradient, or a custom image from disk.
background.unsupportedImage: Unsupported image. Use a JPG or PNG file.
background.imageReadFailed: Could not read that image file.

crop.title: Crop
crop.dragInstruction: Drag on each side to adjust the crop area

imageUpload.jpgOnly: Please upload a JPG, JPEG, or PNG image file.
imageUpload.errorReading: There was an error reading the file.

annotation.title: Annotation Settings
annotation.supportedFormats: Supported formats: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP
annotation.tipMovePlayhead: Move playhead to overlapping annotation section and select an item.
annotation.tipTabCycle: Use Tab to cycle through overlapping items.
annotation.imageFormatsOnly: Please upload a JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image file.

customFont.urlHelp: Get this from Google Fonts: Select a font → Click "Get font" → Copy the @import URL
customFont.nameHelp: This is how the font will appear in the font selector
customFont.errorEmptyUrl: Please enter a Google Fonts import URL
customFont.errorInvalidUrl: Please enter a valid Google Fonts URL
customFont.errorExtractFailed: Could not extract font family from URL
customFont.errorTimeout: Font took too long to load. Please check the URL and try again.
customFont.errorLoadFailed: The font could not be loaded. Please verify the Google Fonts URL is correct.

audio.title: Audio
audio.help: Clean up speech, shorten pauses, and prepare the final mix.
audio.cleanVoiceSaveFailed: Clean Voice could not be saved.
audio.evenVolumeDescription: Keep speech at a consistent level between clips.
audio.pacingDescription: Tighten long gaps without removing speech.
audio.deliveryDescription: Prepare the complete mix for upload.
audio.normalizeVolumeDescription: Master the complete video to a safe upload level.
audio.targetLoudnessHelp: Integrated loudness for the complete exported video.
audio.peakCeilingHelp: Maximum true peak before AAC encoding.
audio.youtubeNote: Klippt's safe upload target. YouTube does not require one exact LUFS level.

pauses.title: Pauses
pauses.help: Find long quiet moments, preview the result, and add selected cuts as normal timeline trims.
pauses.transition: Rendered cuts use {{duration}} ms audio smoothing.
pauses.needsTranscript: No transcript yet. Speech detection still works, but word timing cannot add extra protection.
pauses.speechModelUnavailable: Silero speech analysis is unavailable. Use Audio level without the model.
pauses.noMicrophone: No isolated microphone track was found. Use Audio level for older or imported media.
pauses.usingMixedAudio: This file has no isolated microphone track. Audio level is using the mixed track.
pauses.analysisFailed: Pause analysis failed. The timeline was not changed.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.clipToBoundsDescription: Keeps the cursor inside the video frame. Turn off to let the cursor extend past the edges - useful when zoomed in or panned.
cursor.help: Cursor rendering from the recorded telemetry: theme, size, smoothing, motion blur, and click-bounce emphasis.

transcript.title: Current transcription
transcript.help: Aggregated transcript of every clip on the timeline. Backspace / Delete a word or selection to mark it as skipped (red). Hover a red span to restore it.
transcript.whisperHint: Transcription runs locally on your computer. No data leaves the device.
transcript.noClipTranscript: No transcript for this clip — open the asset card and regenerate.
transcript.noAudio: This media has no audio track

captions.noTranscript: Captions are read from the media transcript. Transcribe this video to turn them on.
captions.derivedFromTranscript: {{count}} caption lines, derived live from the transcript.
captions.hiddenHint: Captions come from this media's transcript. Turn them on to see them in the preview and in exports.
captions.legacyAnnotations: This project still contains caption annotations from the old captions feature ({{count}}). They render on top of the caption layer.
captions.translateHint: Translate the transcript with the configured AI provider
captions.correctionOriginalOnly: Switch the display language to Original to correct transcript words.
captions.selectToCorrect: Select a caption in the timeline to correct its words.
captions.correctionUnavailable: This caption has no source word timing to correct.
captions.correctionHint: Keep one word per field. Corrections update every use of this recording. Audio, timing and saved translations stay unchanged.
captions.correctionInvalid: Enter one non-empty word per field, up to 100 characters.
captions.correctionSaveFailed: The correction could not be saved. Try again, or select the caption again if the project changed.
captions.translationIsNonDestructive: Translations are stored beside the transcript, never in it — the original text and its timings stay untouched.

automaticReview.title: Review effects
automaticReview.hint: Keep protects an effect from regeneration. Remove excludes matching suggestions. Manual edits stay unchanged.
automaticReview.reasonUnavailable: Trigger not saved in this project.

reason.speech-with-quiet-screen: Speech while the screen is quiet

automaticReview.dismissed: {{count}} effects excluded. Different timing or framing can produce new suggestions.
automaticReview.saveFailed: Could not save this review change. Your previous edit is preserved.
automaticReview.saved: Review saved. Use Undo to restore the previous edit.
automaticReview.recordingRequired: Automatic edits need a recording in this timeline. Imported videos and older projects may not include recording evidence.

panels.correctionHint: Select a word to correct it. Timing stays unchanged.
panels.microphoneRequired: Clean Voice needs a separate microphone track.
panels.cleanupUnavailable: Voice cleanup is unavailable on this device.
panels.clickBounceHelp: How strongly the cursor responds to a click. Zero turns the bounce off.
panels.transcriptRead: Click a word to move the playhead.
panels.transcriptEdit: Click to seek. Select words and press Delete to cut.
